comment: Vault (encryption level 3) vectors, generated by gen_vault_vectors.mjs with node:crypto. Do not edit by hand. Format: docs/E2E-VAULT-FORMAT.md. Passwords and keys here open nothing but these files.

secrets.password: vault vector password, not a real one

canonical_4mib.comment: The same operations, the same DRBG seeds, packs of 2^22 bytes. Only hashes: an implementation writes them and compares.

repack.comment: A branch of the fixture from its generation 3 on, packs of 2^16: generation 4 writes three files, 5 deletes two of them, and 6 is the repack a writer runs after that commit. Hashes and layouts only; an implementation replays generations 1 to 3, then these, and compares. `repack` is the set S (Repacking), in table order.

generations.drbg_seed: filex vault vectors v1 repack generation 4
filex vault vectors v1 repack generation 5
filex vault vectors v1 repack generation 6

body_cases.name: minimal
body_cases.why: one folder and one 5-byte file

body_cases.name: ext_is_skipped
body_cases.why: a reader skips extension bytes; a writer that meets them stays read-only

body_cases.name: zero_tail
body_cases.why: zero bytes after the body are padding

body_cases.name: nonzero_tail
body_cases.why: the padding after the body must be zero

body_cases.name: body_version_2
body_cases.why: a body version this reader does not know

body_cases.name: flags_unknown
body_cases.why: an unknown flag bit is a required feature

body_cases.name: sibling_order
body_cases.why: siblings out of byte order

body_cases.name: sibling_order_bytes_not_locale
body_cases.why: "Zebra" before "alfa": bytes, not a locale

body_cases.name: parent_forward
body_cases.why: a parent must come before its child

body_cases.name: parent_is_file
body_cases.why: a parent must be a folder

body_cases.name: not_preorder
body_cases.why: a folder subtree must follow its folder directly

body_cases.name: duplicate_name
body_cases.why: two siblings with the same name

body_cases.name: name_slash
body_cases.why: a name with "/"

body_cases.name: name_dotdot
body_cases.why: the name ".."

body_cases.name: name_empty
body_cases.why: an empty name

body_cases.name: extent_sum
body_cases.why: extents add up to 20 bytes, a 5-byte file needs 21

body_cases.name: extent_in_header
body_cases.why: an extent may not start inside the pack header

body_cases.name: extent_past_pack
body_cases.why: an extent may not run past the end of a 2^16-byte pack

body_cases.name: extent_pack_index
body_cases.why: an extent names pack 1 of a one-pack table

body_cases.name: pack_unreferenced
body_cases.why: the pack table lists only packs an extent uses

body_cases.name: pack_table_order
body_cases.why: the pack table is in ascending byte order

body_cases.name: empty_with_content
body_cases.why: a 0-byte file has no content

body_cases.name: sized_without_content
body_cases.why: a file with bytes has content

body_cases.name: grave_in_table
body_cases.why: a graveyard pack may not also be live

body_cases.name: grave_future
body_cases.why: a pack cannot die after this generation (5)

body_cases.name: grave_ok
body_cases.why: a graveyard entry, sorted, disjoint, died 2 ... 5

body_cases.name: varint_nonminimal
body_cases.why: entry count 0 written as 0x80 0x00

body_cases.name: truncated
body_cases.why: the body ends inside an entry

body_cases.name: chunk_log2_small
body_cases.why: a chunk size below 2^10

negative.name: wrong_password
negative.do: unlock with "vault vector password, not the real one"

negative.name: index_renamed
negative.expect: generation 4 is damaged (its header says 3); readers show generation 3 read-only and say the latest is damaged; writers refuse to write

negative.name: index_bitflip
negative.do: flip bit 0 of byte 1000 of v/idx/0000000000000003.fxi
negative.expect: generation 3 is damaged; readers show generation 2 read-only and say so; writers refuse to write

negative.name: index_wrong_size
negative.do: append one zero byte to v/idx/0000000000000003.fxi
negative.expect: generation 3 is damaged (the size is not its Padme size)

negative.name: pack_bitflip
negative.do: in generation 2, flip bit 0 of the byte at offset 1000 of the third extent of Belgeler/Arşiv/büyük.bin
negative.expect: that file fails as damaged; not.txt of generation 2 still reads

negative.name: marker_req_extra
negative.expect: the key file is refused as malformed

negative.name: marker_vault_v2
negative.expect: refused: the vault needs a newer filex

negative.name: marker_kek
negative.do: set the marker fmk to "kek" and drop fmk_pw
negative.expect: the key file is refused as malformed (a vault always has a wrapped FMK)
